summary: The PR addresses the issue of missing full inverse trig function names for acsc and asec in the LaTeX printer. However, it lacks additional tests and documentation.

issues.description: No new tests were added to verify the behavior with 'inv_trig_style="full"' for acsc and asec.
The change should be accompanied by updated documentation to reflect the addition of acsc and asec to the full inverse trig function names.
